LockedDesc: Lucia is trying out a new hobby.
UnlockedDesc: At Liv's suggestion, Lucia has started gardening. She checks on her seedlings every day.

LockedDesc: Someone said they spotted Lucia somewhere up high.
UnlockedDesc: Lucia believes the bustle of people is proof of their hopes for the future.

LockedDesc: Lucia is thinking in front of a canvas.
UnlockedDesc: Lucia's Froggie drawing has been praised as "vivid and adorable." She came to the art gallery specifically to improve her skills.\nEncouraging her is also part of a Commandant's duty.

LockedDesc: Greet Teddy, who's watching a movie.
UnlockedDesc: Teddy sometimes tests her "new toys" at the Babylonia Universal Cinema. Drop by if you want to see how it's going.

LockedDesc: Find Teddy walking around the square.
UnlockedDesc: To make her compositions more interesting, Teddy collects sound samples around Convergence Square.

LockedDesc: Teddy gazes at the projection, lost in thought.
UnlockedDesc: The projection at the art gallery is Teddy's work, though she doesn't think it's perfect yet.

LockedDesc: Vera seems deep in thought in front of the movie poster.
UnlockedDesc: Vera is often mistaken for one of the performers, and people frequently ask her for autographs.\nMaybe you could ask her for one too?

LockedDesc: From time to time, a vivid red figure can be seen at Dreamglow Gardens.
UnlockedDesc: When she has some free time, Vera goes to Dreamglow Gardens to relax.

LockedDesc: Vera seems to want to talk about supplies.
UnlockedDesc: Vera helps check the delivered supplies. As thanks, you could treat her to a drink.

LockedDesc: When lilies are in bloom, Bianca always visits Dreamglow Gardens.
UnlockedDesc: And so, a promise was made with Bianca to admire the flowers together every spring. Life works that way—once spring's wishes come true, we begin to long for summer's. The seasons turn, year after year.

LockedDesc: While waiting for the movie to start, Bianca always takes time to enjoy the view at Universal Square.
UnlockedDesc: As Bianca watches the scenery from the bridge, those watching the scenery are also watching her.\nEvery beautiful moment in life feels like a scene unfolding on film.\nNow, say that line.

LockedDesc: In the theater lobby, Bianca still hasn't decided what to watch next.
UnlockedDesc: The more Bianca understands how stories are made, the higher her standards become.\nNo longer carried forward by others' narratives, she has begun writing her own script.

LockedDesc: Rosetta likes places with plenty of plants.
UnlockedDesc: Greenery is a luxury in Arctic regions, and that's exactly what makes it so beautiful. Rosetta often comes here to think. If you have time, you might hear some of her stories from the Arctic.

LockedDesc: Rosetta seems interested in the projection at the square.
UnlockedDesc: The glow of the projection reminds Rosetta of habits from her past. In her view, no matter where people are, what they seek is often the same.

LockedDesc: Rosetta can be found near the whale projection.
UnlockedDesc: The whale projection has caught Rosetta's attention. From the way she describes it, riding on Derek's back would be an extraordinary experience. Maybe try it next time.

LockedDesc: Dreamglow Gardens offers many opportunities for children at the Youth Center to learn about ecology.
UnlockedDesc: Wanshi's return gift comes in the form of fun ecological facts and playful bee pranks. What the children receive, however, is an image of their homeland and a precious bond with their teacher.

LockedDesc: With a bit of planning, movie theaters are great places for a nap.
UnlockedDesc: Wanshi's Odd Jobs exists to help whenever people run into trouble.\nWanshi is such a gentle soul.

LockedDesc: Wanshi seems to have booked a visit to an art exhibition at the Olympia Art Gallery.
UnlockedDesc: After carefully studying WGAA's organizational practices, Wanshi has completed two-fifths of the proposal to establish the Hibernation Association, even though the co-proposer still has no idea it exists.

LockedDesc: Slipping naturally into work mode, even at the Logistics Center—that's Lee's "talent."
UnlockedDesc: As everyone knows, maintaining the Gray Raven Commandant's exoskeleton has become part of Lee's daily duties. However, who should handle the "body measurements" part of the preparation... is still up for debate.

LockedDesc: Lee often seems to rest in a spot near the Military Security Area in the Knowledge Promenade.
UnlockedDesc: Maybe the ice cream really was that good that day. Lee often chooses this place to unwind. Life keeps changing, but thankfully, the people around us stay the same.

LockedDesc: Standing by the window at Dreamglow Gardens, you can see the silent expanse of the universe.
UnlockedDesc: When talking about the past, many things turn out to be different from what we remember. Those differences are like a cat's secrets. They have to be whispered more softly than a kitten's meow, or someone might notice.

LockedDesc: Even Asimov struggles to decide what movie to watch.
UnlockedDesc: Recommending films from unfamiliar genres is usually a good way to help meticulous researchers relax and enjoy a story. For Asimov, who "knows everything," it doesn't seem to work.

LockedDesc: The Science Council is also one of the organizing bodies behind Dreamglow Gardens.
UnlockedDesc: Asimov has a lot on his mind: Punishing, Constructs, new "research subjects" occasionally brought back by the Gray Raven Commandant, and... making sure every survivor gets a proper meal.

LockedDesc: A busy Logistics Center, and an even busier Asimov.
UnlockedDesc: Asimov assigns different notification tones to different contacts as a basic priority system. But who he replies to first is purely a matter of personal favo—no, personal feeling.
